d6ceb80b-62a2-49d5-9c8b-6ad5bf8722d2.data: Mitosis is a process where a single cell divides into two identical daughter cells through cell division.
d6ceb80b-62a2-49d5-9c8b-6ad5bf8722d2.text_lemmatized: Mitosis is a process where a single cell divides into two identical daughter cells through cell division.

018dbd52-d6b6-4fe1-8564-acf778a01753.data: Mitosis has five phases: Interphase, Prophase, Metaphase, Anaphase, and Telophase.
018dbd52-d6b6-4fe1-8564-acf778a01753.text_lemmatized: Mitosis has five phases: Interphase, Prophase, Metaphase, Anaphase, and Telophase.

90feac88-ae9c-48eb-b389-2faf969cdaa0.data: During Interphase, the DNA in the cell is copied in preparation for cell division, resulting in two identical complete sets of chromosomes.
90feac88-ae9c-48eb-b389-2faf969cdaa0.text_lemmatized: During Interphase, the DNA in the cell is copied in preparation for cell division, resulting in two identical complete sets of chromosomes.

1ccd56b2-ad7b-4869-982b-29e463cb4021.data: In Prophase, chromosomes condense into X-shaped structures that can be easily seen under a microscope, and the membrane around the nucleus dissolves away releasing the chromosomes.
1ccd56b2-ad7b-4869-982b-29e463cb4021.text_lemmatized: In Prophase, chromosomes condense into X-shaped structures that can be easily seen under a microscope, and the membrane around the nucleus dissolves away releasing the chromosomes.

da10a7ca-d868-4d6c-8759-d94e57ce5bdb.data: During Metaphase, the chromosomes line up neatly end-to-end along the center of the cell, and the mitotic spindle fibers attach to each of the sister chromatids.
da10a7ca-d868-4d6c-8759-d94e57ce5bdb.text_lemmatized: During Metaphase, the chromosomes line up neatly end-to-end along the center of the cell, and the mitotic spindle fibers attach to each of the sister chromatids.

534118dd-a4b6-418b-9551-e1de75950130.data: In Anaphase, the sister chromatids are pulled apart by the mitotic spindle, with one chromatid going to one pole and the other chromatid to the opposite pole.
534118dd-a4b6-418b-9551-e1de75950130.text_lemmatized: In Anaphase, the sister chromatids are pulled apart by the mitotic spindle, with one chromatid going to one pole and the other chromatid to the opposite pole.

9885f852-1627-4fc0-8c39-37f4ad5ad64d.data: In Telophase, a full set of chromosomes gather together at each pole of the cell, and a membrane forms around each set of chromosomes to create two new nuclei.
9885f852-1627-4fc0-8c39-37f4ad5ad64d.text_lemmatized: In Telophase, a full set of chromosomes gather together at each pole of the cell, and a membrane forms around each set of chromosomes to create two new nuclei.

c9e39d0c-7c8d-489e-98dc-42c7cf491ac6.data: The purpose of mitosis is for growth and to replace worn-out cells, and mistakes made during mitosis can result in changes in the DNA that can potentially lead to genetic disorders.
